inspiration.observed_pattern: A grouped aggregate report compares ordinary AVG, conditional AVG(CASE ...), AVG(DISTINCT), and AVG(DISTINCT CASE ...) values over the same group, excluding NULL inputs before aggregation.
inspiration.mysql_mariadb_translation: Reauthored as a cohort metric report with new names, rows, and purpose. Each cohort reports the all-value average, the duplicate-sensitive even-value average, the distinct-value average, and the conditional distinct even-value average; NULL observations are filtered before grouping.

fixture_notes: Cohort alpha contains duplicate even value 2 plus values 3 and 4, making the ordinary even average 2.6667 while the distinct even average is 3. Cohort beta contains duplicate odd value 5, even value 6, and one NULL; its distinct average is 5.5 and conditional distinct even average is 6.
determinism_notes: Observation IDs, cohort labels, metric values, parity condition, NULL input, grouping key, and final ordering are fixed. No clocks, randomness, sleeps, or concurrent connections are used.
setup: CREATE TABLE cohort_metrics (observation_id INT PRIMARY KEY, cohort_code VARCHAR(12) NOT NULL, metric_value DECIMAL(8, 2) NULL)

steps.sql: SELECT cohort_code, AVG(metric_value) AS average_value, AVG(CASE WHEN metric_value % 2 = 0 THEN metric_value ELSE NULL END) AS average_even_value, AVG(DISTINCT metric_value) AS average_distinct_value, AVG(DISTINCT CASE WHEN metric_value % 2 = 0 THEN metric_value ELSE NULL END) AS average_distinct_even_value FROM cohort_metrics WHERE metric_value IS NOT NULL GROUP BY cohort_code ORDER BY cohort_code

checks.sql: SELECT observation_id, cohort_code, metric_value FROM cohort_metrics ORDER BY observation_id
